general.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI has finally arrived — and Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier calls it a “masterpiece” after spending more than 45 hours with the game. He discusses the extraordinary detail and scale of Rockstar’s latest blockbuster, the record demand surrounding its launch and how GTA VI earned a 99 score on Metacritic, making it the highest-rated game ever on the review aggregator. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Anthropic Slides as AI Selloff Deepens
general.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at Anthropic shares falling after its blockbuster stock market debut, as part of a wider global tech selloff hitting the AI trade. And: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived with record-breaking demand. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Anthropic Investor Sees Huge Runway Beyond Coding
general.summary: Anthropic shares are retreating after their blockbuster debut, but T. Rowe Price’s Emma Norchet says the volatility doesn’t change the firm’s long-term outlook. One of Anthropic’s largest private investors, T. Rowe also participated in the IPO. Norchet discusses the company’s improving compute economics and the growth opportunity beyond coding, from knowledge work and cybersecurity to biology and robotics. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Fed’s Paulson Argues for Deliberate Rate Hikes to Tame Inflation
general.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia President Anna Paulson said she’d be open to considering back-to-back interest-rate hikes at the central bank’s upcoming policy meetings to help contain inflation, but said officials should move at a “deliberate” pace.

general.title: Big Take: Can Anthropic Weather a Shifting AI Landscape?
general.summary: Volatility surged a day after the market debut of Anthropic. Worries over AI, geopolitics and rates are all weighing on investors’ appetite for risk. Ed Ludlow and Bailey Lipschultz join Sarah Holder on the Big Take podcast to explain. (Source: Bloomberg)
